instruction: Lis la question, puis écoute le récit en anglais. Pour l’entendre encore, appuie sur Écouter. Le lexique est affiché.

items.prompt:
Chloe and Sam were at the bus stop.
The bus was late.
Sam said, “Let’s walk, it’s only ten minutes.”
Chloe answered, “No, it’s raining!”
Five minutes later, the bus arrived.
items.question: Qui voulait y aller à pied ?
items.spoken: Chloe and Sam were at the bus stop. The bus was late. Sam said: Let’s walk, it’s only ten minutes. Chloe answered: No, it’s raining! Five minutes later, the bus arrived.
items.hint: Écoute qui dit let’s walk (allons-y à pied) : le nom est juste avant said.
items.explanation: Sam said, “Let’s walk” : c’est Sam qui veut marcher. Chloe répond non, parce qu’il pleut (it’s raining).

props.title: Suivre un récit
lines: Qui parle ? Écoute le nom juste avant ou après said (a dit), asked (a demandé), answered (a répondu).
first = d’abord ; then = ensuite ; when = quand ; so = alors ; but = mais
lost = a perdu ; found = a trouvé ; broke = a cassé ; ran away = s’est sauvé
a bench = un banc ; a ticket office = un guichet ; snow = la neige ; a cook = un cuisinier
kicked = a tapé dans ; tasted = a goûté ; thanked = a remercié

items.prompt:
On Saturday, Ben lost his phone in the park.
He looked everywhere, but he didn’t find it.
On Monday, his teacher called him.
A girl from his class found the phone under a bench.
Ben thanked her with a box of chocolates.
items.question: Où la fille a-t-elle trouvé le téléphone ?
items.spoken: On Saturday, Ben lost his phone in the park. He looked everywhere, but he didn’t find it. On Monday, his teacher called him. A girl from his class found the phone under a bench. Ben thanked her with a box of chocolates.
items.hint: Écoute la phrase avec found (a trouvé) : under veut dire sous.
items.explanation: She found the phone under a bench = elle a trouvé le téléphone sous un banc, au parc. La fille est de sa classe (from his class), et c’est le professeur qui a appelé Ben.

items.prompt:
Anna wanted to surprise her mum.
First, she cleaned the living room.
Then, she went to the shop and bought some flowers.
When she came back, her mum was already home.
Anna laughed and said, “Happy birthday, Mum!”
items.question: Qu’a fait Anna avant d’aller au magasin ?
items.spoken: Anna wanted to surprise her mum. First, she cleaned the living room. Then, she went to the shop and bought some flowers. When she came back, her mum was already home. Anna laughed and said: Happy birthday, Mum!
items.hint: Avant le magasin, c’est la phrase avec first.
items.explanation: First, she cleaned the living room = d’abord, elle a nettoyé le salon. Then (ensuite), elle est allée au magasin acheter des fleurs.

items.prompt:
A woman ran to the ticket office.
She said to the man, “One ticket to York, please!”
The man answered, “Sorry, madam, the last train left five minutes ago.”
She sat down on a bench and waited for the morning.
items.question: Où se passe l’histoire ?
items.spoken: A woman ran to the ticket office. She said to the man: One ticket to York, please! The man answered: Sorry, madam, the last train left five minutes ago. She sat down on a bench and waited for the morning.
items.hint: Écoute ce qui est parti il y a cinq minutes : un avion, un train ou un bus ?
items.explanation: Un guichet (ticket office) et le dernier train (the last train) : on est à la gare. À l’aéroport, on parlerait d’un avion (a plane).

items.prompt:
In March, Leo’s family planned a day at the beach.
They woke up early on Sunday.
But when they opened the door, there was snow everywhere!
So they stayed at home and built a snowman.
items.question: Pourquoi la famille de Leo est-elle restée à la maison ?
items.spoken: In March, Leo’s family planned a day at the beach. They woke up early on Sunday. But when they opened the door, there was snow everywhere! So they stayed at home and built a snowman.
choices: Ils se sont réveillés trop tard
Il y avait de la neige partout
items.answer: Il y avait de la neige partout
items.hint: Écoute la phrase qui commence par but : qu’ont-ils vu en ouvrant la porte ?
items.explanation: There was snow everywhere = il y avait de la neige partout. So (alors) ils sont restés et ont fait un bonhomme de neige. Ils s’étaient levés tôt (early), pas tard.

items.prompt:
On Wednesday, Nina phoned her grandmother.
“Can you come to my football match on Saturday?” she asked.
Her grandmother said, “Of course! I’ll bring your little brother.”
On Saturday, they both came, and Nina scored a goal.
items.question: À qui Nina parle-t-elle au téléphone ?
items.spoken: On Wednesday, Nina phoned her grandmother. Can you come to my football match on Saturday? she asked. Her grandmother said: Of course! I’ll bring your little brother. On Saturday, they both came, and Nina scored a goal.
items.hint: Écoute la 1re phrase : Nina phoned (a téléphoné à) qui ?
items.explanation: Nina phoned her grandmother = Nina a appelé sa grand-mère. Le petit frère, c’est la grand-mère qui l’amène au match.

items.prompt:
Jake and Tom were playing football in the garden.
Tom kicked the ball too hard.
It broke Mrs Lee’s window, next door.
First, the boys ran away.
Then, they came back and said sorry to her.
items.question: Juste après la vitre cassée, qu’ont fait les garçons ?
items.spoken: Jake and Tom were playing football in the garden. Tom kicked the ball too hard. It broke Mrs Lee’s window, next door. First, the boys ran away. Then, they came back and said sorry to her.
items.hint: Écoute la phrase avec first, juste après la vitre cassée.
items.explanation: First, the boys ran away = d’abord, les garçons se sont sauvés. Then (ensuite), ils sont revenus s’excuser (said sorry).

items.prompt:
In the canteen, Lucas looked at his plate.
“Fish again!” he said.
The cook smiled and answered, “No, it’s chicken today.”
Lucas tasted it: it was chicken, and it was very good.
items.question: Qui a dit que c’était du poulet ?
items.spoken: In the canteen, Lucas looked at his plate. Fish again! he said. The cook smiled and answered: No, it’s chicken today. Lucas tasted it: it was chicken, and it was very good.
items.hint: Écoute qui dit it’s chicken : le nom est juste avant answered.
items.explanation: The cook answered, “No, it’s chicken today” : c’est le cuisinier (the cook) qui parle. Lucas, lui, croyait que c’était du poisson (fish).
